title: Delete and Recover Business Central Environments

facts.text: Deleted environments enter soft delete phase for 14 days; can be recovered during retention or permanently deleted after.
Environments with Creating Failed or Removing Failed status are permanently deleted immediately; not retained.
Deleted environments automatically renamed with suffix format -yyMMddHHmmssff to allow reuse of original name.
Soft-deleted environments do not receive updates but remain part of update schedule until permanent deletion.
Linked Power Platform environments cannot be deleted; must unlink first.
Select Environments > Recently deleted environments, choose environment, optionally modify pending update, then select Recover and confirm.
Early access preview environments deleted due to failed update cannot be recovered; normal deletions recoverable until new build release.
